Definition: Meshek, a son of Japheth, and the people descended from him
BiblicalUsage: Meshek is a son of Japheth and the people that came from him, traders and warriors in the north. Genesis 10:2 and 1 Chronicles 1:5 both list Meshech among the sons of Japheth, and Ezekiel 27:13 has Javan, Tubal, and Meshech trading persons of men and vessels of brass in the market of Tyre.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the nations of the table are real peoples with real trades, and Tyre's market bought men as well as brass.
